dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My immediate superior wants me to approve the contractor's proposals for clearing out the ruins of the Fontaine Research Institute and reconstructing the Callas Line to ensure the project isn't delayed."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But the Maison Gestion leadership wants me to take my time reviewing the proposals carefully. Who should I listen to?"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Why not just have them ask the omnipotent 'Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale'? After all, it decides all matters of right and wrong here in Fontaine."
